help.pageSubtitle: Find answers to frequently asked questions and available contact channels.
help.contactBody: If you cannot find the answer you are looking for, you can reach us through the following channels.

faq.q: How can I view my traffic sanctions?
faq.a: Go to the «Mobility» section and select «My sanctions».

easyRead.title: Easy read
easyRead.intro: This is what you can do on the Help page:
easyRead.p1: If you have a question, first look in the frequently asked questions.
easyRead.p2: If you cannot find the answer, you can write to the email or call the phone number shown above.
easyRead.p3: We answer by phone from Monday to Friday, from 9 am to 6 pm.
easyRead.p4: You can also read the glossary to understand technical words.
